title: Apophasis

inlines.v: APOPH'ASIS, noun [Gr. from, and form of speech.] In rhetoric, a waving or omission of what one, speaking ironically, would plainly insinuate; as, 'I will not mention another argument, which, however, if I should, you could not refute.'
